newsitem.title: USA: Republic shareholders OK AutoNation deal.
newsitem.headline: Republic shareholders OK AutoNation deal.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc shareholders on Thursday approved the acquisition of AutoNation USA, a used car retailing business controlled by Republic Chairman Wayne Huizenga.
A Republic official said that at a special meeting, 99.9 percent of voting shareholders approved the deal.
At Wednesday's closing price for Republic shares, the stock acquisition is worth about $646 million.
Huizenga's original $19 million stake in AutoNation is now worth about $236 million in Republic stock.
Republic is a diversified services group buying properties in waste-management, auto retailing and car renting.
